lines.text: Sennacherib captured all Judah's fortified cities, and Hezekiah sent word to him at Lachish offering to pay whatever he demanded.
Hezekiah gave the king of Assyria the silver from the LORD's house and stripped the gold from the temple doors.
The Assyrians came to Jerusalem with a great army, and the Rabshakeh said Hezekiah was trusting in Babylon.
Hezekiah's officials asked the Rabshakeh to speak in Aramaic, but he shouted in Hebrew to the people on the wall.
The Rabshakeh asked whether the gods of Hamath and Arpad had delivered Damascus, but the people stayed silent.
